description: Boulder County Public Works publishes stormwater outlet points for its drainage asset inventory. The layer defines outlet shape, elevation, number of openings, energy dissipators, receiving drainage destination, road location, ownership and maintenance. Part of the inventory came from the 2017 Storm Drain System mapping project; county staff also used drainage plans, field work and spatial information. These outlet locations and attributes provide boundary and asset information for stormwater-network simulation. The county publishes outfalls as a separate layer with different fields. The exact distinction between the two asset classes, their overlap and their connection to pipe segments remain unverified. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue. The county overview has inconsistent licence wording; this record preserves the explicit layer-feed licence URL.
